title: Diffraction of waves by finite thin coatings: asymptotic expansion and effective models
summary: We consider the Helmholtz equation in a Dirichlet angular sector (which may be locally perturbed) covered on one side by a thin homogeneous layer. First, we propose an asymptotic expansion of the solution at any order and for any angle when the thickness of the layer tends to 0, using a matched asymptotic expansion. This consists in introducing different asymptotic expansions in three subdomains -- the vicinity of the corner, the layer and the rest of the domain -- that are linked through matching conditions. The presence of the corner makes these matching conditions delicate to derive…
